title: banchi uses the shared typecheck hook and drops its own
why: banchi runs tsc twice today: once through its own scripts/typecheck-hook.py, and once through the shared hook that claude-settings #1612 (step repo-typecheck-hook) adds (coordinator, 16:23 CST Nov 7).
note: Waits on #1612. After it merges, banchi adds a 'typecheck' entry to .claude/layout-extras.json with ["node","app/node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc",...], and deletes scripts/typecheck-hook.py. The coordinator starts it on #1612's merge. Done check: one tsc run per edit in banchi.
